owner.requests: Requests collect new service inquiries as they move through review and qualification. Qualified requests can progress through walkthroughs, proposals, and service setup.
owner.requestDetail: This record keeps the request, walkthrough, proposal, and service setup together. Each stage preserves the information needed for the next operational decision.
owner.walkthrough: Walkthroughs capture the property's operational needs before service is proposed. A completed walkthrough can provide the basis for scope and pricing.
owner.proposal: Proposals organize the proposed scope, frequency, and pricing for client review. An accepted proposal can progress to service agreement and account setup.
owner.serviceAgreement: Service agreements record the proposed service terms for client review. Their status reflects the client's response before recurring operations begin.
owner.commercialAccounts: Commercial accounts represent active or planned service relationships after the sales workflow. They connect service details, scheduling responsibility, and account status.
owner.clients: Clients connect the people or organizations associated with leads, properties, proposals, and service accounts. Their records keep relationship history together as work progresses.
owner.clientDetail: This record brings the client's contacts and related operational records together. New leads and service relationships remain connected to the same client history.
owner.propertyDetail: This property record keeps service details, inventory, job history, and calendar connections together. Updates here support future scheduling and field work.
owner.inventoryTemplates: Inventory templates define reusable supply standards that can be applied to properties. Property inventory can then be maintained from a consistent baseline.
owner.jobs: Jobs represent scheduled field work and its progress from assignment through completion. This view provides operational oversight across properties and workers.
owner.jobDetail: This job brings together assignments, progress, photos, notes, and approvals from scheduling through completion.
owner.calendar: The calendar brings scheduled jobs into a time-based operational view. It helps teams identify coverage, timing, and potential scheduling conflicts.
owner.workers: The worker roster brings access, operational role, onboarding, and eligibility information together. Worker records support assignment readiness and ongoing compliance review.
owner.workerDetail: This record brings together the worker's access, onboarding, role, and operational readiness. Changes here may affect future assignments and available platform access.
owner.documents: Documents brings client-facing templates and worker-facing company records into one administrative area. Each document type remains available within its relevant workflow.
owner.workerDocuments: Worker documents support onboarding and compliance across the company. Access and review status show which records are available and where owner follow-up may remain.
owner.companyProfile: Company profile details supply the business identity used across SCRUB. Updates may appear in generated documents and other client-facing records.
owner.payments: Payments brings operational payment records and partner settlements into one place. Each area tracks a different payment relationship and can be reviewed separately.
owner.cleanerPayments: Cleaner payments track completed work and its payment status by worker. Records here support payment review and reconciliation.
owner.settlements: Settlements track amounts associated with work shared between partner companies. Statuses document review and reconciliation between the participating companies.
owner.performance: Performance summarizes completed work and available quality signals across the team. It supports ongoing operational review.
owner.partners: Partner Companies supports cross-company work sharing. Connections established here can affect job visibility, responsibility, and settlement records.
owner.siteSetup: Your public site presents the company's services and collects new client requests. Published details shape what prospective clients see before entering the request workflow.

worker.availability: Availability records when you are generally able to work. Scheduling teams can use it when reviewing future assignments, while confirmed jobs remain visible in Jobs.
worker.settings: Worker Settings brings profile, work preferences, onboarding records, documents, payments, and account connections together.
worker.manuals: Manuals provide company standards and reference material used during field work. Available manuals remain accessible here for ongoing review.
worker.payments: Payment history shows payment records associated with completed work. Individual entries provide the status and details recorded in SCRUB.

client.agreementReview: This agreement records the service terms provided for your review. Its status updates after an available response is submitted.
